Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 39

“What I have told you is the understanding of Sankhya; now hear the understanding of Yoga. Equipped with this insight, Partha, you will cast off the bondage of action.”

Krishna labels his own teaching in two halves, analysis and then practice. The promise is specific: not escape from action, but freedom from the way action normally binds the one who acts.
